filter.ref_scope: Migrate the complete main ancestry, including merged branches. Unmerged branches and all original PRs remain in the private original repository. No tags existed in the migrated scope.

history_policy: Keep every main-ancestry commit, including empty roots, merges and excluded-only changes. Preserve author, committer, dates, message and parent structure; hashes change when filtered trees or parents change.
Five original signed commits lose their signatures when rewritten because those signatures authenticate the original IDs. Exact signed originals remain in the private source repository.
Filter every historical tree to the reviewed literal paths, relocating original game additions to client/. Historical shared game files, assets, SDKs and build inputs are excluded.

Current shared-file integration is reconstructed in client/pokeplatinum.patch. Historical game snapshots deliberately omit the excluded shared edits; consult the private original for exact historical builds.
The Global Terminal event diff at the source head changes JSON formatting only and is omitted. Current game behavior is preserved without that reformatting.
New migration files and necessary path corrections are separate LUNE-297 work after filtered_head; they do not alter the preserved commit records.
empty_commit_policy: Empty commits and merges are retained, not squashed or pruned. The commit map includes every original main-ancestry commit.
publication_gate: Keep replacement and original repositories private. Publication and original-repository archival require their separate reviewed gates.
